jobs.title: Deputy Information Technology Director
jobs.description:
Deputy Information Technology Director

Information Technology

The Carnegie Endowment for International Peace, a global network of policy research centers, is seeking a full-time Deputy Information Technology Director to serve as the deputy to the CIO and lead day-to-day IT operations and cybersecurity. The position supervises the Cybersecurity and Network Administrator, the Cloud Systems Administrator, and the Help Desk Administrator, and oversees the IT office when the CIO is unavailable.

The position oversees Carnegie's cybersecurity program, including security tools, incident response, and network infrastructure in Washington, DC and at Carnegie's five global centers. Key tools include EDR, SIEM, vulnerability management, threat exposure, email threat protection, phishing simulation, DLP, and other security and network management systems. The position works with the CIO to set security priorities, assess emerging threats, and report on security posture to management.

In partnership with the CIO, the position also helps develop multi-year IT and network plans, build business cases and budget recommendations, manage key service providers, and align technology initiatives with organizational goals. The role also contributes to business continuity and disaster recovery planning and keeps IT policies and documentation current.

The position oversees Carnegie's cloud environments and productivity suites. Knowledge of firewall configuration, PowerShell, and network architecture is highly valued; experience with enterprise AI solutions, agentic AI governance, and MCP configurations is a plus.

Candidates should have 15+ years of progressive IT leadership experience, including overseeing helpdesk operations, developing IT strategic plans, and partnering with executive leadership. Experience managing cybersecurity programs and cloud environments at scale is highly desired, as is experience at nonprofits. A bachelor's degree in a related field (or equivalent experience) is preferred; certifications such as CISSP, PMP, ITIL, or Cisco/Microsoft credentials are a plus. The ideal candidate is a strong communicator and mentor, comfortable working at both strategic and hands-on levels.

This hybrid position requires working onsite at Carnegie's Dupont Circle office in Washington, DC at least 3 days a week, with occasional off-hours onsite work, including for security incidents. Carnegie offers an outstanding work environment and generous benefits, including health insurance. The expected salary range is $150K - $170K.

Please apply via the Carnegie Endowment website by submitting a resume and cover letter.
Equal Employment Opportunity.

jobs.title: Director of IT - Bilingual in Spanish
jobs.description:
Salary: to $150,000 base + discretionary bonus
Reports to: CEO
Location: Stafford, TX
Fluent Spanish required

Do you love being the bridge between the business and the people who build its systems? Our client, a growing company, is seeking a technology leader who can turn real operational needs into well-designed software and systems, then lead the team that brings them to life.

You'll guide a Mexico-based software development team, partner closely with the CEO and department leaders, and oversee the full technology picture, including business systems, IT infrastructure, cybersecurity, and compliance. You don't need to write code yourself. You do need to understand how software and systems are designed well enough to define requirements, weigh tradeoffs, and ask the right questions before resources are committed.

Your impact:
• Translate business challenges into clear technical requirements, system designs, and development priorities
• Lead projects end to end, from requirements and design through testing, deployment, documentation, and ongoing support
• Build and own the technology roadmap, budget, and KPIs, and share progress, risks, and recommendations with executive leadership
• Make sure the infrastructure is secure, reliable, and scalable across on-premises and cloud environments
• Oversee user provisioning, access controls, software licensing, hardware lifecycle, and employee technical support
• Hold the MSP, consultants, and technology vendors accountable for service, security, and results
• Partner with the Compliance Officer on ISO 27001, audits, business continuity, and disaster recovery
• Bring fresh ideas for automation, AI tools, integrations, and process improvement
• Step in hands-on to troubleshoot whenever the situation calls for it

Your background:
• A proven track record leading people and managing multiple technology projects at the same time
• Experience managing or partnering closely with software development teams across the full development lifecycle
• Familiarity with application architecture, databases, APIs, integrations, cloud applications, and source control
• Exposure to ERP systems, custom software, or other business application platforms
• A solid grasp of networking, servers, Microsoft 365, endpoint management, firewalls, identity and access management, backups, and disaster recovery
• Knowledge of cybersecurity best practices and risk management
• ISO 27001 or similar security framework experience, with a strong habit of documentation and audit readiness
• The business judgment to prioritize wisely and the confidence to present costs, risks, and options to executives
• Fluency in Spanish (required)

Bonus points for:
• Hands-on development, systems engineering, or infrastructure configuration experience
• Experience building or growing the technology function at a small or mid-sized company

If you're a collaborative, organized leader who gets energized by connecting technology to business results, let's talk.

jobs.title: Senior Manager, IT PMO
jobs.description:
We respectfully request that 3 rd parties refrain from contacting us regarding this posting.

Overview

LABUR is partnering with a client to identify a Senior IT PMO Manager to serve in a strategic leadership capacity focused on building, maturing, and scaling a modern IT PMO. This individual will partner closely with IT leadership and business stakeholders to drive alignment between business strategy, portfolio investments, governance, and delivery execution. The role centers on establishing the processes, governance frameworks, and operating disciplines that ensure technology initiatives are prioritized effectively, funded appropriately, executed predictably, and measured against expected business outcomes. Collaborating across business functions, Finance, Enterprise Architecture, Cybersecurity, delivery teams, and external partners, this leader will facilitate strategic portfolio planning, demand management, governance reviews, investment prioritization, and performance management activities. This role requires the ability to influence senior leaders, navigate ambiguity, drive organizational change, and balance strategic thinking with operational execution.

The ideal person is a transformational PMO leader who thrives in building or maturing PMO capabilities within complex organizations and can help evolve the project, program, portfolio, and governance practices to support future growth, scalability, and digital transformation objectives.

Responsibilities

Spearhead governance, portfolio management, and delivery excellence practices across the IT organization, including stage gates, executive reviews, risk management, and delivery standards.
Facilitate portfolio prioritization, funding decisions, and executive trade-off discussions to ensure investments align with strategic goals.
Create and oversee PMO governance processes, stage gates, executive reviews, risk management, and delivery standards
Drive delivery predictability through structured planning, dependency management, issue resolution, and vendor oversight.
Manage enterprise demand, capacity, and investment planning processes to enable informed prioritization and resource allocation.
Collaborate with IT Finance and business leaders on business cases, capital and operating budgets, ROI analysis, and investment decisions.
Ensure technology investments achieve measurable business outcomes through benefits realization, KPI tracking, and value management.
Utilize advanced analytics, automation, and AI-enabled capabilities to enhance portfolio visibility, decision quality, forecasting, and operational efficiency.
Build PMO capabilities through coaching, mentoring, talent development, and continuous improvement while championing organizational adoption through stakeholder engagement and change management.
Identify opportunities to accelerate value delivery, improve organizational agility, and increase return on investment across the technology portfolio.
Lead organizational adoption of PMO practices through stakeholder engagement, change management, communication, and executive sponsorship alignment.

Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Business, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field; advanced degree preferred.
10+ years of progressive leadership experience in program management, portfolio management, PMO leadership, or enterprise transformation.
Demonstrated track record of building, transforming, and maturing PMO functions within complex organizations, including leading enterprise technology portfolios and large-scale cross-functional initiatives.
Deep expertise in portfolio governance, investment management, financial planning, risk management, and Agile, Waterfall, and hybrid delivery methodologies.
Experience leveraging enterprise portfolio, project management, and analytics platforms to enable governance, resource planning, delivery execution, and executive decision-making.
Strong executive presence with the ability to influence senior leaders, build cross-functional alignment, and lead effectively through ambiguity; demonstrated success driving organizational change and business value realization.
PMP, PgMP, PfMP, PMI-PMO CP, SAFe, or related certifications preferred.

Compensation

$80-$85/hr - Dependent on fit and experience

jobs.title: Senior Product Cybersecurity Technical Program Manager
jobs.description:
Job Description

THE ROLE

The Senior Technical Program Manager role sits within the broader Product Cybersecurity organization at General Motors and helps the team scale its impact through disciplined program management, measurable maturity, and strong internal customer partnerships. The role connects cybersecurity strategy to execution by improving program health, coordinating complex initiatives, and helping leaders deliver effective services to the teams we support.

What You’ll Do

Own product cybersecurity frameworks and maturity models, using them to assess program health, identify material gaps, and prioritize improvement
Coordinate high-value initiatives that require technical analysis, stakeholder alignment, dependency management, and disciplined execution
Partner with Product Cybersecurity leaders to design, package, and deliver services to internal customers with a consulting mindset
Define and track KPIs that show whether programs are healthy, performant, and delivering expected outcomes
Translate complex technical and organizational information into clear plans, decisions, executive updates, and actionable recommendations
Establish practical workflows, operating rhythms, and governance mechanisms that improve prioritization, visibility, and delivery
Build a strong network of technical program managers to simplify partnership across shared priorities and critical focus areas

Required Qualifications

8+ years of experience in roles directly within a cybersecurity team or at a cybersecurity company
Demonstrated experience in technical program management, consulting, deployment engineering, security engineering, or a related role
Experience implementing cybersecurity frameworks and maturity models, such as NIST CSF, BSIMM, or comparable approaches
Comfortable coordinating complex initiatives across multiple stakeholder groups in a matrixed organization
Knowledge of modern project and program management methodologies, workflows, and tooling, including Jira, Git, or comparable platforms used by engineering teams
Strong communication, judgment, and execution skills, with the ability to create structure and drive measurable outcomes through ambiguity

Preferred Qualifications

Experience in automotive, embedded, connected-product, software-defined vehicle, or other complex product environments
Experience delivering cybersecurity services through an internal consulting or service-delivery model
Experience defining operational metrics, dashboards, or other mechanisms for measuring program health and performance
Understanding of how to use AI to improve the quality, speed, and efficiency of high-fidelity work production
Prior hands-on experience in cybersecurity and/or formal education in a related field of study
Experience working with technical delivery organizations and adapting quickly through self-study, research, and experimentation

What You’ll Bring

A clear focus on providing exceptional experiences for internal customers
The ability to build trust quickly through proactive outreach, effective networking, and dependable partnership
A practical approach to unblocking others, bringing order to chaos, and making difficult work simple
A commitment to making the team 1% better every day through small changes with meaningful impact
Strong judgment, follow-through, and collaboration when priorities shift or information is incomplete

GM does not provide immigration-related sponsorship for this role. Do not apply for this role if you will need GM immigration sponsorship now or in the future. This includes direct company sponsorship, entry of GM as the immigration employer of record on a government form, and any work authorization requiring a written submission or other immigration support from the company (e.g., H1-B, OPT, STEM OPT, CPT, TN, J-1, etc). This role is categorized as remote. This means the selected candidate may be based anywhere in the country of work and is not expected to report to a GM worksite unless directed by their manager. Relocation benefits are available for candidates who qualify under company policy.
